prior_recipe_differences: Independent 32K byte BPE instead of Llama2 tokenizer

Shared reduced head dimensions across controls; not original head counts or state dimensions
Preserve dense FFNs at both boundaries, one initial and one terminal layer; 114-layer original has two initial and five terminal dense layers
131072 nominal token slots per update (32 document rows); valid target tokens vary with document lengths, rather than the published 0.5M-token batch
config.network: mandatory OS denial; no online mode

network: mandatory seccomp denial before model creation
